items.name: dsh-project-memory
items.desc: Project memory for dsh with native task-system integration: session todos and file reads auto-condense into cross-session task records (task↔file links), so workflows are switchable and resumable without re-contextualizing. Read-time memory (no upfront scan): extracts code symbols, summarizes docs, and cross-links docs↔symbols; optional TS semantic enhancement (auto on when TS installed). Experience notes auto-dedup. Every recall includes a traceable citation. Pure JS, single dep, works out of the box, silent operation, zero overhead.

items.name: dsh-forge-studio#plugin-memory
items.desc: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: agents save, search and update user preferences, facts and project decisions; important entries are injected into later sessions, and a Settings section lists, edits, archives or deletes them.

items.name: dsh-codevault
items.desc: Reading archive for dsh: after reading open-source code, capture quick notes or write full deep notes that group into one card per repo / file / symbol, stored as an append-only log of Markdown notes you can open in Obsidian; query your history, browse recent reads, or search your own Obsidian vault and link related notes to a reading record. Nine tools, a /codevault command, and a code-reading skill.

items.name: dsh-prompt-errornotes-desk
items.desc: Captures the agent's own self-reported mistakes into a categorised lesson library that is re-injected into the system prompt every turn (each captured draft is confirmed or edited by the user before it is recorded), and adds two conversation-header panels for editing the cross-conversation global prompt and a per-session prompt.

items.name: agent-body#dsh-cortex
items.desc: The memory organ of Agent-Body: after 2 minutes of silence it enters light sleep and after 5 minutes deep sleep, where deterministic rules distil real experience into memory cards (pitfalls, playbooks, hotspots, unresolved issues, facts). Incoming commands recall related cards by keyword and inject them into context; cards unused for long decay on a half-life and are archived rather than deleted. It also de-noises body-wide homeostasis warnings: repeats inside a window are counted instead of re-printed, and a warning that keeps recurring without ever healing converges into a known steady-state offset and goes quiet. Consolidation and recall make no model calls.

items.name: dsh-ledger-memory
items.desc: Project-level memory built around a ledger whose structure the AI designs per project; the plugin only handles detection, injection, write-back, archiving and git. Memories are split by meaning: the active ledger holds current state, the turn journal is append-only, and decisions, the goal tree and lessons are one-card-per-file (with a multi-dimension index over the card folders); the fundamental principles file can be changed only by the user. There is a single compaction mode: before compacting, the AI sorts the work into three buckets - what must stay in context and is re-injected verbatim, what is written to the project's _stash/ for later lookup, and what is dropped. When a conversation is opened in a container workspace holding several projects, it can be locked to one sub-project (the lock lives in the plugin's own home and survives restarts; it leaves no marker in your project). Also an activity log with five levels, where L4 stores the user's own words verbatim (never injected, queryable on demand). Before each compaction a verbatim capsule (user quotes, raw errors, changed files) is written to disk, and both the capsule and its source material survive a restart; a handoff document lets a new conversation resume the previous one. 21 tools, 12 subcommands, 39 settings (one of them switches whether the settings panel or each project's manifest wins). Runs locally, no runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-plugin-memos-code-retrospect
items.desc: Coding retrospect distilled memory for DSH: distills rejected solutions, pitfalls and constraints from each turn via a local LLM, tags them into MemOS (type:rejected_solution), and boosts weighted recall on coding tasks via agent/pre-step.

items.name: feiyu-memory
items.desc: Cross-session persona and diary for DeepSeek Harness: a local gate decides whether a turn is worth remembering, then one extra model call turns it into a first-person diary entry plus an impression of the user, where every impression carries the specific moment that produced it. Later conversations inject about 2000 tokens of that as a self-memory block in three registers: a persona core, a section for judgements the model wrote itself, and the diary. There is a tool for the model to record a judgement in its own words, and a plain markdown hand-note file the human can write into which the plugin only ever reads. A sidebar panel lets you read, forget or export the archive, and forgetting demotes an entry rather than deleting it, so an old one still surfaces on a strong topical match. Local-only, secrets are stripped before anything is sent, and the archive is a plain folder you can read, edit or carry to another account. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.

items.name: dsh-memory-connect
items.desc: Cross-session memory plugin for DSH (v0.6.1, npm @asherliner/dsh-memory-connect): auto-extraction, SQLite FTS5 indexing, RRF semantic recall injected into the system prompt every turn, scheduled maintenance, LLM-powered consolidation via ctx.llm, context explosion prevention, and global Soul identity via ~/.dsh/soul.md. v0.5.0 added temporal context graph (valid_from/valid_until/supersedes, append-only corrections via reviseMemory), trust model (recalled history injected as untrusted reference, current instruction always wins), turn-end summarization. v0.6.0 added local semantic embeddings (BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 via embed_server.py, cosine + RRF fusion with FTS5, no cloud calls, ~232 msgs/sec on CPU). v0.6.1 fixed ~ expansion in path config. Zero-config install.

items.name: dsh-memory-triage
items.desc: Memory triage for DeepSeek Harness: at the end of each turn it decides which entries to keep and which to archive, routes project-specific ones into a project bucket while global ones stay in the main store, merges near-duplicate entries, and falls back to an LLM when the rules are unsure — automatic actions are recoverable archives only, never deletions.

items.name: dsh-memory
items.desc: Long-term memory scoped to the DSH workspace. A session opens with a one-line-per-memory index - bodies are fetched on demand by the `memory` tool, so the same character budget holds about three times as many entries - and when a turn ends a purely local search over the last user message pulls the matching memories into the next briefing at no model cost. Optional auto-capture distils a stretch of conversation into structured memories; in draft mode they wait in an approval queue instead of landing directly. A portrait layer keeps a workspace and a global picture, rewritten from the journal and the records, with the same draft-or-direct choice. Settings → Memory holds the archive, list and timeline views, a health check (duplicate clusters, stale entries, broken links), the supersede version chain with rollback, and a read-only scan that imports existing WorkBuddy / Qoder memory files.

items.name: dsh-zcode-scribe
items.desc: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness, read-only as of 0.1.0: a scribe_recall tool that reads a plain-markdown memory room, path rules that refuse directory traversal, Unicode smuggling and NTFS alternate data streams, and a bounded index whose truncation is always reported rather than silent.

items.name: dsh-kb-rag#npm-package
items.desc: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 10 tools (kb_ingest, kb_search, kb_rag, kb_zotero, kb_dedup, kb_clear, kb_fetch, kb_scope, kb_stats, kb_status), hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, all-local bge embeddings over a single-file SQLite index. Needs Python 3.9+ with pymupdf, faiss-cpu and sentence-transformers; the `npx dsh-kb-rag-install` installer sets those up and pre-downloads the model.

items.name: dsh-context-zip#dsh-context-zip
items.desc: Replaces the built-in DSH compaction summarizer with a five-section handoff summary and keeps every shadowed message readable in a segment directory.

items.name: dsh-longterm-memory
items.desc: Local Markdown long-term memory for DSH: an Obsidian-compatible vault, a sidebar management page, four memory tools, and budgeted per-turn recall.

items.name: busabase-dsh-plugin
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Busabase: search workspace knowledge, work with structured records and apps, submit writes as reviewable ChangeRequests, and inspect results in live cards.

items.name: deepddw#ddw-teams-panel
items.desc: Adds a multi-user settings panel to the DSH web client: usage-mode selection, member management with online status and device binding, and switching or sharing of per-member memory and knowledge bases.

items.name: better-basicfun
items.desc: Native DSH foundation bundle that registers a persistent default workspace, provides paged read-only inspection of plugins, skills, memory, sessions, storage, settings, credentials, and DSH_HOME files, and synchronizes rich CLIProxyAPI model capabilities into native provider settings.

items.name: dsh-inbox
items.desc: Personal paste inbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): /inbox in the composer or the sidebar panel files links, images, text and credentials into a local vault, classifies them by local rules and then by a rate-capped model pass, and browses, searches and edits them from the panel; the assistant retrieves records on request in conversation, credential bodies stay encrypted at rest, and an optional WebDAV or S3 remote syncs records and attachment bytes. Windows only so far.

items.name: dsh-evolve
items.desc: Cross-session memory with zero-token deterministic recall (bigram-Jaccard fused with FTS5 BM25 via RRF, Chinese-aware tokenization), reinforcement that strengthens repeated observations, and procedures crystallized into SKILL.md files refined in place through an active-stale-archived lifecycle with reversible archive and rollback. Ingest and disposal each expose a user-chosen autonomy tier; conflicts and high-importance writes always go to human review, and nothing is ever auto-deleted. Requires Node 22.5+.

items.name: dsh-compound-memory
items.desc: Launches the local compound-memory MCP server through uvx and injects a short usage reminder once per session.

items.name: dsh-context-imports
items.desc: Reads the files that AGENTS.md references with @path imports and injects their content into model context at session start, with byte budgets, compaction re-seeding and a six-language settings card. v0.2.3 targets DSH 0.1.7+ (hardened for 0.2.0-rc.2+); use 0.1.x on DSH 0.1.5.

items.name: dsh-journal-calendar
items.desc: A daily journal the agent keeps: the journal_record tool appends dated todos and memories, with optional detail and tags, to one JSON file per day under the DSH home; the right sidebar draws those files as a month calendar marked per day by open todos, finished todos or memories, with checkable todos and the selected day's entries below; and the duty sentence it adds to the system prompt is editable from the calendar itself.

items.name: dsh-memory-evolve
items.desc: A purely plugin-based implementation that brings "cross-session long-term memory + background self-evolution" capabilities to DeepSeek Harness: five-track memory · git branch awareness · in-turn self-review · skill self-evolution and skill manager · four-track to-do · COI scheduling · session broadcast · session search · prompt manager · temporary info notes—zero core modifications, zero runtime dependencies, ready to use upon installation and completely removable upon uninstallation.

items.name: dsh-learn-wiki
items.desc: Knowledge base with a corrective acquisition loop for DeepSeek Harness: when the agent keeps hitting the same failure, a background worker fetches the web under a rate limit, distills the result into a staging area, and only a two-stage commit makes it recallable — pages without sources are refused.

items.name: dsh-living-memory
items.desc: Self-tending living memory in one local SQLite file — a nightly patrol dedupes, merges, decays and cross-links entries on its own, with seven-signal RRF hybrid recall (FTS5 + jieba Chinese-first tokenization, optional vector KNN, graph PPR), a typed knowledge graph, conflict detection instead of silent overwrites, and web telemetry panels.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-memory
items.desc: A /remember command that writes facts into the AGENTS.md instruction hierarchy dsh already loads, plus a Memory tab showing which instructions the loader kept within its byte budget.

items.name: stratagate-agentmemory
items.desc: Recent conversations stay vivid. Older ones fade into summaries, not oblivion. StrataGate gives DeepSeek Harness six-layer, time-decaying memory, while lasting events and relationships settle into a knowledge graph. Bring your memories from other AIs with you—no need to start over.

items.name: interest-memory
items.desc: Cross-session long-term memory backed by a local Go service (~50MB RAM, SQLite-vec + verify-augmented claims): zero-lag recall injection on every user message, session-end transcript ingest, and memory_search / memory_logs / memory_ingest tools. Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add @djasdh/interest-memory-dsh-bridge`. Protocol bridge only: the Go service is not installed by `dsh plugin add` — install and start it per the repository README first; until it runs, the tools silently return nothing.

items.name: dsh-prime-memory
items.desc: Layered memory for DSH whose agent-facing surface is 10 tools: high-privilege writes (memory_add, memory_delete, memory_import), rumination controls (memory_ruminate, _cancel, _status), and a memory graph (memory_search_graph, memory_expand_graph_node), built over an L0-L3 distillation pipeline that recalls and injects relevant memories before each model step.

items.name: dsh-self-improvement
items.desc: Cross-session memory as plain Markdown per workspace: weighted injection, bi-temporal invalidation, TTL review with stale markers, credential redaction, error and session retrospectives, SOP skills, and approval-gated self-improvement proposals.

items.name: eduwork#dsh-memory
items.desc: Local semantic memory and prior-chat retrieval with source references, editable memories, retention, forget controls, undo, and JSON import/export.

items.name: dsh-observational-memory
items.desc: Distills session work into background observations and reflections to preserve context across compaction.

items.name: akasha-book#akasha-gate
items.desc: Write guard for the Akasha Book store: blocks tool calls that write into the memory data directory, and injects the store usage contract and self-layer sections into the system prompt. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (or set the AKASHA_DIR env var); plugins fail loudly while the placeholder remains.

items.name: akasha-book#akasha-hooks
items.desc: Records host events — turn ends, tool results, agent errors, idle transitions and assistant output — as append-only JSONL for Akasha metrics, recall checks and output audit. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (or set the AKASHA_DIR env var); plugins fail loudly while the placeholder remains.

items.name: akasha-book#akasha-sleep
items.desc: Schedules Akasha sleep distillation on idle or timer, and injects a wake note for new sessions plus a per-turn memory pulse; the optional idle-resume behaviour is off by default. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (or set the AKASHA_DIR env var); plugins fail loudly while the placeholder remains.

items.name: akasha-book#mcp-akasha
items.desc: Registers the Akasha Book memory server over stdio and exposes its 22 akasha_* tools to DeepSeek Harness, covering lookup, briefs, revision chains, audits and session recall. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (or set the AKASHA_DIR env var); plugins fail loudly while the placeholder remains.

items.name: dsh-memory-eternal
items.desc: A self-contained second brain for DeepSeek Harness — auto-captures durable dialogue knowledge into a local Markdown vault (custom dedup, CJK search, git-friendly), with a graphical knowledge base and an interactive knowledge graph (legend filter, time-dimension coloring, box-select, merge, delete, PNG export/import).

items.name: memory-eternal
items.desc: Self-built DSH memory plugin: SQLite persistent storage + database-level audit guard (enforceAudit) + audit log. Auto-captures knowledge after conversations, agents recall via memory_recall, supports Claude Code/Codex/Cursor multi-agent sharing. Zero external dependencies.

items.name: evolver-dsh-plugin
items.desc: A harness that gets smarter the more you use it, with no more goldfish memory. Before each prompt, Evolver recalls one proven strategy from your local history and the EvoMap network; after the turn it grades that strategy by the checks that ran, whether the edits were kept, and how you replied, then reports back to the network, which weighs it by evidence. Every success becomes a shortcut for next time, and every failure becomes a warning.

items.name: dsh-agentic-roleplay#state
items.desc: Persistent SQLite session state, story memory and recall, repositories, and model-facing record tools for DSH roleplay plugins.

items.name: dsh-mnemosyne-memory
items.desc: Permanent memory plugin for DSH with vector search, LLM reflection, and knowledge pages.

items.name: dsh-hybrid-memory
items.desc: Three-layer local memory for DeepSeek Harness: L1 snapshot memory (MEMORY.md/USER.md) read on demand through the memory_* tools + L2 searchable knowledge base (facts + SQLite FTS5, Chinese search via sliding-window tokenization) + L3 import from Hermes/Claude Code/Codex/WorkBuddy and from approved Agent Hub documents (memory/global, memory/projects, accepted decisions) with content-hash dedup. v0.2.0 removed every automatic injection: memory enters the context only when the model calls one of the 12 memory_* tools, and data stays on the local drive.

items.name: cross-session-memory
items.desc: Cross-session lesson book (the agent wrong-answer notebook) for DeepSeek Harness: injects a memory index capped at 2 KB verbatim into every turn, adds mem_recall and mem_save model tools whose write gate demands four sections, a locatable reference and explicit human approval before anything reaches disk, registers the /memory command, and keeps every lesson as a zero-dependency Markdown entry in the .memory/ directory.

items.name: dsh-claude-memory
items.desc: Read-only bridge that surfaces Claude Code's existing project memory in DSH — git-root-aware resolution, credential redaction before injection, and an on-demand recall tool. Zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-greatarrow
items.desc: Connects dsh to the GreatArrow.ai MCP server over Streamable HTTP, so the agent can search and save workspace memories, tasks and decisions shared with your other AI clients; a config-only bundle that reads the token from great-arrow.token in the dsh home, never from the environment.

items.name: siyuan-codex-bridge
items.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SiYuan (思源笔记) desktop app: registers its note tools as mcp__siyuan__<tool>, exposes the AI configured in SiYuan together with its agent loop as one more tool, ships a notes skill, and enforces a readonly/authoring/full profile on every call while keeping the tool list available when the app is closed.

items.name: dsh-palate
items.desc: An accumulated design-taste corpus for DSH agents: feed good and bad examples, distill principles, and review new designs against learned judgment rather than a fixed ruleset.

items.name: dsh-instruction-memory
items.desc: Standing instructions edited in the DSH settings UI and injected into the system prompt of every subsequent turn.

items.name: dsh-memory
items.desc: Persistent conversation memory for DeepSeek Harness: memory tab, automatic AI naming, per-AI privacy isolation, sidebar AI names, and automatic experience archiving. A static profile plugin available in every preset without disappearing on restart.

items.name: dsh-memory
items.desc: Claude Code-inspired Auto Memory meets Codex-inspired Session consolidation, bringing simple, transparent, and context-efficient long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-hindsight-local-optimize
items.desc: Local-memory lifecycle for the official Hindsight plugin on DSH desktop: one-click start/stop of the hindsight-embed daemon, auto-start on boot, stop on exit, hides the uv.exe console window, and installs the vault/models to another drive.

items.name: dsh-tool-user-memory
items.desc: Local Markdown user and project memory for DSH: pinned preferences, keyword search, soft invalidation, history and archive, and JSON migration with preview, backup and rollback.

items.name: dsh-memory-spaces
items.desc: Human-governed cross-session memory spaces with independent source and consumer relationships, provenance, versioning, and pre-send injection review.

items.name: dsh-adaptive-context
items.desc: Governed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only evidence ledger with write guards, 7-tier authority claims, supersede chains, and budgeted pre-step injection with per-domain quotas.

items.name: dsh-inject-scheduler
items.desc: Injection scheduler for DeepSeek Harness injection planes: cross-plugin sections register/order/account on the official storageDomain, with conflict detection and per-session budget summaries (B10 panel data source).

items.name: dsh-kb-lite
items.desc: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: five tools to ingest Markdown, plain text and PDF files, search them with BM25 or hybrid BM25 plus optional local embeddings, and answer with cited source passages. Runs offline with no database server. Requires Node.js 18+ and Python 3.9+; PDF ingest needs pymupdf.

items.name: dsh-llm-wiki
items.desc: Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern knowledge base for DSH: wiki-write/wiki-search skills, zero-dependency pipeline (lint/index/mnemon memory sync/quality feedback), minimal lifecycle plugin injecting schema + knowledge preview, SiliconFlow semantic recall via an Ollama-compatible proxy.

items.name: dsh-memory-semantic
items.desc: Read-only semantic retrieval for meow-memory: a local bge-m3 vector index over memory entries and conversation turns, a knowledge graph, and verbatim turn recall. Never writes back to the memory store; requires meow-memory.

items.name: dsh-hindsight-memory
items.desc: Hindsight long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: injects relevant memories before each turn and retains finished turns to a Hindsight bank. Requires DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1 (verified on 0.2.0-rc.2).

items.name: causal-memory#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Causal memory for dsh: a zero-dependency MCP stdio bridge that mounts the 17 tools of the causal-memory server under clean names (no mcp__ prefix) — decision → outcome edges with typed relations (caused / enabled / prevented) in a local SQLite store that survives compaction — plus a pinned system-prompt section. Requires the causal-memory server binary on PATH (pip install causal-memory, or a prebuilt release).

items.name: dsh-memories
items.desc: Dual-ledger cross-session memory: auto-extracts lasting facts from conversations into MEMORY.md and maintains a PROGRESS.md project ledger, recalling both into every new session.

items.name: dsh-clear-mind
items.desc: Model-autonomous context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: a mind_map tool surveys the agent context surface (stable seq ids, roles, token weights, clear-boundary markers, the clear-mind playbook), a clear_mind tool replaces a chosen conversation-history span with a model-written checkpoint through the native compaction transaction, call and result pairs self-collapse into one-line tombstones, and a proactive reminder nudges the model when the context grows long or a turn runs too many steps.

items.name: dsh-memj
items.desc: A project-scoped memory plugin for DSH. Knowledge authoring and the plugin's own prompts are open to editing, so users can redesign the library structure and how the model is driven without changing a line of code. By default the library is built on one core idea: a project document you design yourself (a handoff by default) is the project entity; the plugin detects which project a session belongs to, binds captured knowledge to that project, and promotes what generalizes into theme and global layers. The most natural logic there is does the pre-filtering of knowledge, with controllable compression and archiving of context.

items.name: dsh-headroom-plugin#plugin
items.desc: Runs the upstream Headroom compression toolkit (headroom-ai, Apache-2.0) inside DeepSeek Harness over MCP: headroom_compress, headroom_retrieve and headroom_stats are exposed as mcp__headroom__* tools backed by the upstream server, installed on demand by uvx. Compression is lossy but reversible — originals are fetched back by hash from a local CCR store. Also ships a registrar that adds DeepSeek Harness to Headroom's own MCP registry, and a model-header sanitizer for the upstream proxy.

items.name: dsh-super-memory
items.desc: Cross-compaction memory for a long session: on compaction it stores what is being dropped, and at question time it injects a few relevant passages (or nothing) so the model can recall what you decided before.

items.name: dsh-handoff-compaction
items.desc: Context compression for small-context models: visually configure the compressed context budget, default to an 8k handoff + 16k recent context, and keep full history searchable.

items.name: rag-coding
items.desc: Local code memory with automatic source context, symbol lookup, vector search, and dependency graphs for JavaScript and TypeScript projects.

items.name: dsh-get-memory
items.desc: Pulls GitHub repo content into DSH conversations at start and writes extracted long-term memory back with SHA-locked multi-file commits at conversation end; per-file read/write permissions, native settings page, turn indicators and global change notices.

items.name: dsh-project-memory
items.desc: Polaris Memory: local-first project memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Uses per-project .dsh-memory.json; provides memory_read/recall/write/update/delete tools, /memory command and settings UI, with tiered injection (resident user profile + scene-triggered memories with P1/P2/P3 importance), semantic recall (IDF + synonym layer), and a hard-guard mechanism for bottom-line memories (detect deny-semantics -> authorize -> block AI deletion; user can confirm-override).

items.name: dsh-hermes-memory
items.desc: Scoped persistent memory for DSH: memory_save/search/replace/remove/list across global, user, project and failure scopes, DSH storage-domain persistence with secret and prompt-injection scanning, session-scope search, retention cleanup, and optional session-start injection; standing context via memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin.

items.name: dsh-tiered-memory
items.desc: Tiered persistent memory (user/env/project) with per-tier char budgets and semantic query routing; full layers refuse writes instead of silently evicting.

items.name: context-prism
items.desc: Project-level Local Context Engine for DeepSeek Harness: retrieval/compression/prioritization over history, code, files, user preferences and agent trajectories, producing a dynamic context window for any LLM.

items.name: dsh-workspace-memory
items.desc: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.

items.name: dsh-puzzle-mode
items.desc: Keeps project decisions in plain markdown instead of chat history: one main document plus per-module documents, every entry carrying a file:line citation. The agent interviews you to turn open questions into settled decisions, and a five-dimension score (task complexity, extensibility, maintainability, code quality, reusability) is derived from the documents and shown on a button beside the model picker. A session can bind several projects; projects are sized small/medium/large, which widens the entry limits, and a reusable-pipeline section in the main document is injected when its trigger words appear.

items.name: dsh-local-vector-memory
items.desc: Fully local vector memory for DSH: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automatic recall injection, dedup with conflict detection, soft-delete recycle bin, online backup, and optional LLM extraction.

items.name: dsh-video-coursemap
items.desc: Watches the foreground browser window, recognizes video courses, classifies them by subject, fetches Bilibili metadata/danmaku/comments, and generates Markdown + Mermaid knowledge maps and Word study manuals.

items.name: dsh-plugin-memory
items.desc: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory.

items.name: dsh-hermes-memory
items.desc: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with automatic model distillation, source-linked encrypted session logs, and guarded compaction.

items.name: veyra
items.desc: Engineering intelligence for coding agents — persistent, evidence-aware, project-isolated engineering memory with unified hybrid search (memory + RAG documentation) for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-memory-delta
items.desc: Layered cross-session memory for DSH that pushes only what changed - the first round injects every active entry, later rounds push only added / updated / removed ones, and nothing at all is injected when nothing changed, with keys that merely repeat an entry id left out of the text so the baseline is about 26% smaller. Facts and decisions carry semantic keys (one active truth per key), the model may only write to an inbox that a human promotes, an entry can carry a review date that raises a one-time reminder when due, and search is relevance-ranked with journal lines down-weighted and Chinese matched by bigram. A sidebar tab tells the lifecycle story instead of listing files - entries are grouped by stage (awaiting confirmation / in use / archived) along four axes (topic - one level, human-assigned, type, tag, date), each group can be ticked for batch promote / withdraw / archive / restore / delete / assign topic, and topics can be renamed store-wide or searched on their own. The archived stage reads in three levels - the category says why an entry left (distilled into the docs / useless for good / not needed right now, the first two being defaults you can add to), below it the entry topic stays collapsed until you click it, and entries with no topic sit right under the category. The tab also shows the global and workspace instruction files plus the current injection size. A zero-dependency CLI ships with it, so the store is usable without DSH.

items.name: my-dsh-plugins#tlmemory
items.desc: Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and the plugin ships its own embedded web dashboard (it starts the HTTP server itself, no separate process) for browsing, graphing and controlled deletion.

items.name: dsh-memory-vault#memory-auto
items.desc: Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle, commit, compaction and end checkpoints, storing them via the vault MCP server.

items.name: dsh-memory-vault#memory-mcp
items.desc: Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions, facts, learnings, conventions, profiles and sources.

items.name: dsh-plugin-context-manager
items.desc: Context manager for DeepSeek Harness: auto-summarizes every turn into priority-sorted records, injects them plus pinned cross-session notes and custom text into each model request, and folds any-size real conversation ranges into summaries to save tokens. Persistent and restart-safe. NOTE: manual multi-step install — copy the three package folders into profiles/node_modules and add the provided cordis.patch.yml rows, then restart DSH; not a standard one-command install.

items.name: dsh-inkvault
items.desc: Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's long-term memory with per-turn recall and end-of-turn capture. Pure Markdown with frontmatter, BM25 search, reversible archive, and path isolation that rejects traversal, absolute paths and symlink escapes.

items.name: dsh-experience-memory
items.desc: Cross-session experience memory for DSH. Lessons are evidence-graded, injected when the turn is about the same thing, and shown just before an action only when the record declares which call it applies to. A rule that holds whatever the turn is about — "always answer in Chinese" — can be marked **standing** and is then carried every turn: measured on 24 isolated real-model turns, a standing rule is followed 6/6 against 0/18 for the controls (empty store, same record unmarked, unrelated standing record). A guess still cannot become always-on: a standing record needs a verified passage like any other. What nobody looks up is retired, reversibly. Five tools, seven slash commands, zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: opencontext#dsh-opencontext
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness integration for OpenContext with durable cross-session memory, automatic prompt capture and recall, session summaries, structured insights, and document retrieval.

items.name: lookover#dsh-expmem
items.desc: Personal-experience memory for DSH: turns solved tasks into sourced problem cases with condition-scoped claims, recalls them into new tasks via hidden pre-step injection, and makes corrections/deletes cascade to future recall.

items.name: dsh-plugin-memory
items.desc: Persistent long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a JSON store of typed entries (fact, preference, entity, rule, episodic) exposed as the memory_remember and memory_recall agent tools, with recall ranked by keyword overlap, importance and access frequency.

items.name: dsh-graphmemory
items.desc: DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions, and ships as the npm package dsh-graphmemory.

items.name: dsh-memory-lite
items.desc: On-demand memory for DeepSeek Harness: session logs are distilled into layered markdown (a summary, an index and per-topic files), and a mem_query tool returns only the matched entries rather than the whole index. Nothing is injected per turn, there are no dependencies, and every entry keeps a source pointer back to the conversation it came from.

items.name: dsh-missher-brain
items.desc: Coordinates bounded project recall from compatible memory and learning providers, with shared settings and provider lifecycle management.

items.name: dsh-missher-memory
items.desc: Project-scoped local memory with review-before-recall, source references, reversible consolidation, and a portable Cordis service; the Harness adapter provides search and settings, with optional Brain integration.

items.name: missher-mse-learning
items.desc: Persists scoped user corrections and method candidates for DSH with bounded recall and restart-safe completion settlement.

items.name: dsh-zcode-workspace-memory
items.desc: Workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness ported from ZCode: one Markdown memory directory per workspace (a MEMORY.md index plus one file per fact), injected into each main session and refreshed by a background extraction request after completed turns; a sidebar page browses the stored files read-only.

items.name: dsh-memory-manager
items.desc: ZCode-style persistent project memory with a full settings manager, index-first injection and agent memory tools.

items.name: dsh-plugin-memory
items.desc: Persistent five-layer memory system with relevance injection, LLM auto-extraction, profile rotation, and six agent tools.

items.name: dsh-knowledge-canvas
items.desc: Knowledge base as a canvas in the right sidebar: notes are nodes, and nine tools let the model read, write, link and remove them. A node can carry pictures and documents, and reading one returns their text — Office files extracted in place — while pictures can be handed over as images.

items.name: dsh-cipher
items.desc: Cipher memory platform as a DSH bundle: four memory types (attention, experience, preference, cognitive) sedimented per turn by four memory agents, cross-session deterministic recall injected via systemPrompt.context, insight review kept out of user-facing output, per-session UNNI/LOOP modes with memory-driven auto-continuation, memory search/ingest tools, plus a settings page (SOUL editor) and an AgentPool panel.

items.name: dsh-yuque-kb
items.desc: Yuque knowledge base as external memory for dsh — auto-injects matching document fragments into conversation, with catalogue search, cloud full-text search and online reading.

items.name: dsh-honcho
items.desc: Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the background with secrets redacted, and adds honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember tools plus a /honcho status command; configured through the ~/.honcho/config.json shared with the other Honcho integrations, against hosted honcho.dev or a self-hosted instance.

items.name: dsh-memory-eternal-fork
items.desc: Maintained fork of dsh-memory-eternal: auto-captures knowledge cards into a local Markdown vault and recalls them on demand, with DSH 0.2.0-rc.x compatibility fixes. Original project by EternalNight996 (https://github.com/EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal), MIT.

items.name: dsh-memory-plus#dsh-memory-bundle
items.desc: Memory profile composition with Chinese session search, hybrid recall, persistent workspace facts, user-pinned rules and reusable native skills. Install the standalone versioned Release bundle with one dsh plugin add command. Requires Node.js 24 and pnpm on PATH.

items.name: dsh-memoir
items.desc: Local-only project memory with zero bundled runtime dependencies or external services: JSON as the source of truth plus generated PROJECT_MEMORY.md, token-bounded session-frozen Hot Memory for prompt-prefix cache stability, cached cross-project BM25 recall, trusted session/turn provenance, explainable pre-write duplicate/conflict governance, editable importance/pin/tags/supersede/archive lifecycle, configurable top-level turn-end distillation, and a bilingual Web GUI for search, inspection, diagnostics, and live settings.

items.name: dsh-continuum
items.desc: Persistent project memory, event-sourced task lifecycle, context budgeting, and cooperative multi-agent handoffs.

items.name: dsh-quberi
items.desc: Search the documents and pictures in your Quberi knowledge base, browse its spaces and documents, save notes to it, and upload files into it with your approval for each one, from DeepSeek Harness over OAuth.

items.name: dsh-memory
items.desc: Project+global long-term memory for the dsh web GUI: split POST /items endpoints, tool-call context merged into memory items as compact summaries, with deduplication and session-scoped persistence.

items.name: dsh-simple-wiki-memory
items.desc: A super-simplified LLM-wiki memory plugin: one index document (auto-loaded) + one markdown file per topic (read only when needed) — no dumping everything into the context and burning tokens. Simple and lightweight, painless to install/uninstall, and freely editable however you like.

items.name: dsh-ai-memory
items.desc: Closes ai-memory's consolidation loop for DSH: when a DSH session ends it calls ai-memory finalize-session, so the observations DSH captured become wiki pages the other harnesses ai-memory serves can read. Skips subagents, queues concurrent session ends, and sweeps sessions abandoned by a forced restart.

items.name: dsh-memory-loom
items.desc: Cross-session long-term memory: captures durable facts from each turn, auto-associates them by shared entity and tag, and recalls with BM25 plus spreading activation over the link graph.

items.name: l123-harness
items.desc: Three-tier agent memory harness: L1 always-on CLAUDE.md, L2 index, L3 detail skeleton with templates, a gate that blocks writes to protected files without a one-time approval token, zero-judgement event logging, weekly distillation, and a TDD execution-loop skill.

items.name: dsh-mnemosyne
items.desc: Mnemosyne memory for DeepSeek Harness: remember / recall / forget / stats / sleep tools, embedded skill, auto-setup, optional auto-sync/prefetch, and a Settings panel. Data lives under ~/.dsh/mnemosyne.

items.name: dsh-memory#dsh-memory
items.desc: All-in-one local memory: JSONL files per scope (session, project, global, or a custom name) with per-scope dedup, four model tools (memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_forget), automatic recall injected into agent pre-step, and a settings panel. Retrieval combines lexical IDF with a local embedding backend, which the panel can install and manage itself.

items.name: drafta-mcp#dsh-drafta
items.desc: Connects the Drafta notes app to DeepSeek Harness over MCP, so the agent can search, read and write notes in your local Drafta library.

items.name: dsh-soul-md
items.desc: Manage soul.md persona cards and long-term memory, with workspace and session persona selection and tools to read and update them.

items.name: dsh-tdai-memory
items.desc: TencentDB Agent Memory integration with conversation capture, structured memory extraction, automatic recall, and memory and conversation search tools.

items.name: dsh-memo-notebook
items.desc: Per-workspace memo/todo panel that auto-captures queued and running user instructions, marks preempted tasks as interrupted, and restores them to their previous state with one click.

items.name: dsh-memory
items.desc: Local Git-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with hybrid CJK/English retrieval, cited context, transactional sync, previews, and rollback.

items.name: llm-wiki#dsh-wiki
items.desc: Portable agent knowledge base in plain OKF v0.2 Markdown: 13 wiki_* read/write tools, progressive disclosure, backlinks, gated writes via AGENTS.md rules, auto index/log maintenance, linting, and named multi-bundle switching (session-level or global).

items.name: dsh-lite-memory
items.desc: SQLite memory entries, a calendar with due-time reminders, and cron-scheduled agent tasks, with 13 model tools and a bilingual zh/en UI.

items.name: dsh-engram
items.desc: Zero-LLM auto-capture and a symbolic \[ENGRAM\] index with progressive disclosure, an ESR-lite task/evidence protocol (esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link), and per-workspace usage telemetry with an offline recall benchmark (npm run eval).

items.name: mneme#dsh-mneme
items.desc: The memory that dreams — cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: recalls you and your projects across sessions, consolidates memories while idle (autoDream), freezes conflicting memories for your review, and keeps a replayable audit trail. Memory stays on your machine as SQLite with human-editable Markdown mirrors; four-way recall (keyword, vector, BM25, entity graph) and an interactive memory panel ship with it, plus 10 model tools, an MCP server, an external API and a CLI. Summarization and consolidation run on the host model you already configured; with a local embedder, semantic search runs fully offline.

items.name: dsh-notes-context
items.desc: Notes-backed context compression for DeepSeek Harness: replaces LLM-summarized compaction with a model-written persistent notebook plus recoverable raw history, so the rollover boundary itself costs zero model calls.

items.name: dsh-brainagent
items.desc: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research and proactive initiatives.

items.name: dsh-notes
items.desc: Keeps notes as local Markdown files grouped by directory under a root folder you choose, with a sidebar page, AGENTS-style rule files surfaced as writing context, and six agent tools.

items.name: agent-feedback-loop#agent-feedback-loop-dsh
items.desc: Feeds every dsh prompt into the local agent-feedback-loop feedback-memory pipeline — captures dissatisfaction, reviews it offline into reflections, and attaches the compiled recurrence-rule context back to the turn, never blocking a prompt. Requires the agent-feedback-loop runtime; running agent-feedback-loop install afterwards wires existing dsh profiles automatically.

items.name: dsh-memos-bridge
items.desc: Bridges the MemOS memory service over MCP: the agent gets add/search/update/delete memory, multi-cube sharing, and a memory scheduler as mcp__memos__* tools.

items.name: dsh-context-control
items.desc: A context usage ring with configurable character-based automatic compaction, manual compaction, protected user requirements and recoverable original history for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-akn-plugin
items.desc: Local-first Agent Experience Network for DeepSeek Harness, distilling task-level experiences from traces and live manifests, grading by H0-H4 evidence, discovering by compatibility, and promoting only after explicit review.

items.name: dsh-linghun-memory
items.desc: A memory subsystem for DeepSeek Harness: full ontological memory (event/fact/rule three-ontology) plus a goal system (goal.js) — belief values written via Bridge trigger words, goal activation scored at read time (0.25 domain + 0.35 bridge + 0.40 sim) to recover goal/value long-range associations, journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay, memory_append/read/consolidate plus linghun_goal_update/get/state closed loop. Independent of the original dsh-linghun line. 16/16 on LoCoMo-Plus.

items.name: tabilet-skills
items.desc: Shared engineering skills, a read-only memory-bank dashboard with stages and SQLite audit browsing, and workflow request previews for DSH.

items.name: dsh-long-memory
items.desc: Cross-session long-term memory: a hybrid-retrieval memory store (BM25 plus CJK bigrams), chunked long-document search, chat-log extraction and distillation, and context-summary archiving and browsing, with important memories and the latest summaries auto-injected into the prompt.

items.name: dsh-session-notebook
items.desc: Notes taken from DeepSeek Harness conversations: quotes whole replies or selected passages, keeps highlights rendered at their original position in the session, attaches editable Markdown notes, tags them, filters by workspace or session, and exports Markdown or a full JSON backup stored as local JSON files.

items.name: dsh-trilogy
items.desc: Per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness. Three Markdown files per workspace — PROJECT.md, DECISIONS.md and SESSIONS.md — are auto-created on the first step of any session in that workspace, re-read from disk and re-injected only when they change (and re-injected if compaction dropped them), and written back by classification through a memory_checkpoint tool, with a bounded end-of-turn nudge when a turn did work but recorded nothing. memory_read and memory_search read the live log and the archive, the latter over a zero-dependency BM25 index. The session log is capped at 200 entries with the overflow moved to SESSIONS-archive.md — never injected, but visible, readable and searchable, and restorable one entry at a time. Settings page: a workspace list with a path filter, read-only tabs for the three memory files plus the archive, reload, export/import of one workspace's memory as a JSON bundle, a two-step clear, a panel that rewrites or removes the AGENTS.md instruction block, and a PROJECT.md staleness reminder. A composer status chip shows that workspace's sync state and creates the files on click. Zero dependencies — no vector store, no embeddings, and no model calls.

items.name: dsh-self-evolution
items.desc: Bounded self-managed long-term memory (Hermes-style MEMORY.md / USER.md with hard character limits and a safety scan), a review that runs after every turn and writes plain-language notes or refines an existing skill instead of adding a near-duplicate, a curator that finds and surgically repairs skills the loader would silently discard, cross-session search over past messages, and a learning card above the composer that appears only when there is news and asks before it deletes or rewords a memory.

items.name: dsh-ltm
items.desc: Local SQLite long-term memory with CJK-aware search, BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, and lifecycle management.

items.name: mosaic-memory-compress
items.desc: Forgetting-curve in-place dialogue compression for DeepSeek Harness: recent turns stay verbatim, middle turns are structurally dehydrated (zero-LLM), ancient turns fold into a bounded summary pair — unbounded conversations on a bounded memory budget.

items.name: dsh-relationship
items.desc: Local relationship-memory workbench with a confirmation gate: every AI write — extracted memories and newly created contacts alike — lands in a pending queue until the user confirms it in the GUI; materials are archived verbatim with quote-level provenance checks on AI extraction, and confirmed memories aggregate into per-contact timelines, gift occasions and reciprocity views. Ships a native relationship agent preset for conversation capture; JSON storage by default with an optional SQLite backend, zero production dependencies.

items.name: dsh-llm-wiki-plugin#dsh-llm-wiki
items.desc: An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.

items.name: dsh-plugin-save-token
items.desc: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.

items.name: deja-vu#extensions/dsh
items.desc: Reads the session files thirty-three other coding agents on this machine already wrote — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot Chat, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Kimi, Cline, Zed and more — including sessions from before it was installed: six tools (deja_recall, deja_session, deja_blame, deja_fix, deja_how, deja_remember), a /deja command, and optional automatic recall added to the runtime context. Local BM25 index, no LLM, no embeddings, no network (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja).

items.name: dsh-anima-rag
items.desc: Anima-style vector memory for DSH: injects retrieved historical summaries into the system prompt each turn, exposes an anima_query semantic-search tool, and isolates the vector store per playthrough. SiliconFlow embeddings sent as array-shaped requests; timeouts and provider errors surface as honest, classified notes in the injection slot — never silent.

items.name: dsh-memory-archive
items.desc: RP memory built on pmp tavern: RP history summaries ride the native compaction pipeline, with plain tool sessions kept out of the way. Full recall requires the downstream anima plugin. Requires the plugin-provided roleplay preset to be enabled.

items.name: dsh-xia-plugins#packages/gameassist-memory
items.desc: Single-file persistent companion memory: interests, preferences, tasks, and past works summarized into the system prompt, with read/update tools.

items.name: dsh-mirror
items.desc: Make the AI remember how you think, not what you said: actively captures your principles, redlines, and working habits across sessions — with memory capacity, graceful decay, and human-readable reasoning for every entry. 0.7.0 brings an intuitive persona portrait with evidence tracing.

items.name: context-razor
items.desc: Context trimmer: lists the current session's context entries with role, preview and ≈token estimate (cl100k), highlights over-threshold items, and removes selected entries exactly without LLM summarization.

items.name: hermes-loop
items.desc: Automatic session retrospective: after a conversation wraps up, distills useful experience into reusable skills stored in the skill library for the model to call, with signal-accelerated triggers, manual runs, an approval mode, and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).

items.name: dsh-logseq
items.desc: Syncs Logseq 2.0 DB graphs (including E2EE) with a Logseq sync server via the headless Logseq CLI, adds 11 logseq_* tools to search, query and edit them, and a Settings section to log in and configure sync.

items.name: dsh-dev-progress-memory
items.desc: Per-turn development progress memory: completed turns are classified into date-indexed Markdown files under doc/progress/ with a maintained INDEX.md, system-level bugs are kept in a cross-project SYSTEM_MEMORY.md and re-injected on error keywords, and a progress_read tool loads full documents on demand.

items.name: dsh-memory-file
items.desc: File-backed memory: injects your own Markdown memory file at each session start, adds read/write tools with backup and undo, and reports DSH_HOME drift. Reads no conversations by default; an opt-in autoScan switch surfaces your own recent lines from local session logs. Never opens a network connection.

items.name: dsh-seed-society
items.desc: Memory consolidation tuning for dsh-mneme (autoDream enabled, schema-max output budget, deepseek-chat route) plus the llm-deepseek reasoning-effort fix, an MCP bridge to the auditable seed-society agent runtime, and six yogacara seed skills.

items.name: mylife
items.desc: A local-first personal state record and decision engine for dsh: keeps every input byte-for-byte with line-level provenance, argues against its own conclusions by generating defeaters first, ages each stored fact with its own TTL, and reports where a decision rests on nothing at all.

items.name: dsh-company-kb
items.desc: Local-folder knowledge base for DSH: builds a SQLite FTS5 index over Office, text, PDF and scanned files, ships five tools (kb_search / kb_read / kb_list / kb_status / kb_session) plus a Web panel, and retrieves or syncs only when the user explicitly asks.

items.name: dsh-memory-lite
items.desc: Read-only enhancer for a file-based long-term memory library (markdown cards in git): a memory_find search tool, a small budgeted memory digest injected into the system prompt, and a settings page with library overview, health-check status and toggles.

items.name: dsh-openviking-manager
items.desc: Configuration UI for the official OpenViking memory plugin: connection and user-key setup, local connection diagnostics, a per-session memory toggle in the composer, memory isolation that keeps recall inside the current topic, and recall tuning for score threshold, injected item count, query expansion and excluded URIs.

items.name: minta#dsh-plugin
items.desc: DSH-native integration layer for the Minta memory engine: composes the official dsh-mcp-client row, registers the minta-memory-governance skill plus a session-start memory prewarm, and ships a Minta agent preset; requires the separately deployed Minta engine (Python/Docker) to provide the 19 MCP tools - not usable without it.

items.name: dsh-user-memory
items.desc: User-authored long-term memory in four tiers (must-follow rules, behavior settings, user profile, optional rules), injected as a system-prompt section, with agent tools to propose edits and a Chinese panel where the user reviews and applies them.

items.name: dsh-skill-manager
items.desc: View and delete persistent skill memory from the DSH sidebar.

items.name: dsh-memory-vault
items.desc: SQLite-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: add, search, update and archive entries with categories and tags, automatic conversation logging, tiered compression, and a project dimension that scopes retrieval to the current workspace plus global facts.

items.name: dsh-knj-obsidian
items.desc: Built-in Obsidian-style knowledge base for DSH: agents distill conversations, documents and web sources into a structured .wiki graph, with retrieval, graph export, note editing, incremental builds and multi-vault management.

items.name: dsh-powercontext
items.desc: PowerContext for DeepSeek Harness: WorkBuddy-style project memory and inspectable handoff workflows - bounded context recall before each model step, 19 pc_* tools for memory, handoff, experience and skills, with a Windows server watchdog for resident operation.

items.name: dsh-living-memoir
items.desc: Cross-session memory kept as a short Markdown living document that is rewritten in full at the end of every turn, written to by model tools, the page, and automatic rewriting alike.

items.name: dsh-engramory-recall
items.desc: Local BM25 auto-recall, a fail-closed write guard, a static doctor and a memory panel for an Engramory markdown store. No network, no daemon and no model calls unless you opt in; recall quality is measured by a reproducible benchmark in the repository.

items.name: dsh-cc-haha-dream
items.desc: Background memory consolidation (auto dream) for DeepSeek Harness: periodically reviews recent sessions and existing memories to dedupe, refresh stale entries, remove contradictions and rebuild the MEMORY.md index, with hybrid/volume auto triggers, /dream command and a settings-panel config card.

items.name: dsh-cc-haha-memory
items.desc: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: memory read/write/retrieve tools, per-turn auto-recording, project-scoped recall injection and a management UI, with non-destructive Claude Code memory import.

items.name: dsh-learn-skills
items.desc: DSH plugin: a four-entry learning flow in the session input bar — scaffold a preset, collect candidates, merge reviewed changes, and run a read-only workspace audit.

items.name: dsh-memory-plugin
items.desc: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness with curated facts, automatic turn retention, and graph- and vector-ranked recall.

items.name: dsh-decision-log
items.desc: Decision log for DeepSeek Harness: record key decisions (chosen option + why) into a versionable DECISIONS.md via decision_log / decision_list / decision_audit tools, and auto-inject the summary into future sessions so decisions stay traceable and are never re-litigated.

items.name: dsh-env-profile
items.desc: Global experience archive for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: probes local tools (with versions and PATH-first hits), convenient paths, network latency and disk speed; folds per-session stats from session/event; LLM-extracts durable facts; env_profile tool with remember; byte-stable summary injected every turn to speed up sessions and cut token use.

items.name: dsh-memory-snapshot
items.desc: Injects your existing markdown documents (notes, rules, knowledge-base files) into every dsh session's system prompt as read-only memory — list file or directory paths in `files`; no database, no service, no write path; UTF-8 byte-budgeted truncation with line-boundary fallback, total budget, YAML front-matter stripping, and freshness timestamps.

items.name: dsh-memvault
items.desc: Bridges DSH to a local MemVault store: core memory blocks injected into the system prompt, finished turns extracted through MemVault's own pipeline, and a panel to browse, trace, review and replay what was stored.

items.name: dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-memo
items.desc: Week-keyed personal memo service: stores entries in ISO-week tables, resolves week/month/quarter/year navigation from one period calendar, archives quarters, runs AI analysis and Markdown report export, requires an explicit force flag to edit a past week, and turns one suite-wide telemetry failure analysis into a GitHub issue report.

items.name: dsh-plugin-thread
items.desc: Decision-and-goal memory with lineage: explicit commands and a model tool record decisions deterministically, a status card re-anchors them across compaction, a lossless event stream with BM25+jieba retrieval backs it, and a scenario-level fidelity regression suite gates releases.

items.name: dsh-flomo-report
items.desc: Generate AI-narrated DSH session reports (daily/weekly/monthly, any date range) and sync them to flomo (浮墨笔记) with one configurable tag (default #write/dsh) and automatic # stripping, via a web settings panel with daily reminder.

items.name: dsh-memory-system
items.desc: Local-first persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: bounded pre-step hot-memory injection, exact and Chinese-bigram BM25 cold recall, six agent tools, approval-gated lease-lock writes with recovery receipts, and read-only governance and trajectory-review candidates.

items.name: memsearch#memsearch
items.desc: Shared Markdown memory for DSH and other coding agents, with automatic capture, pre-step context injection, searchable recall, and memory-to-skill self-evolution through a review panel.

items.name: dsh-ecolink#adapter
items.desc: DSH side of the dsh-ecolink memory ecosystem: bridges chat.deepseek.com and DeepSeek Harness through a browser extension that harvests DSM-format memory tags and injects recalled memories into web chats, a zero-dependency local service that writes a shared memory pool, and this adapter, which injects memories pre-step and offers /ecolink-push write-back; compression is transactional (staging pool with commit/rollback).

items.name: dsh-openclaw-memory
items.desc: Share an existing OpenClaw Markdown workspace with DeepSeek Harness as bounded persona and memory context, with Sidebar browsing and editing.
